rows.clue: A proposition deducible from basic postulates

rows.label: PASSPORT

rows.label: FINE PRINT

rows.label: PROSODY

rows.label: DARK COMEDY

rows.label: MINUTE BOOK
rows.clue: A book in which minutes have been written

rows.label: SYLLABLE
rows.clue: A unit of spoken language larger than a phoneme

rows.label: CITE
rows.clue: A short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage

rows.label: BLUE LAW

rows.label: LAST NAME

rows.label: PUPPET PLAY

rows.label: MEDICAL BILL

rows.label: JEREMIAD

rows.label: CHORTLE

rows.label: SPYWARE
